facility.name: Kids Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 5640 US HWY 77A S, YOAKUM, TX, 77995

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver grabbed a child roughly by the arm to place them in time out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a child received an injury while in care that required medical treatment. The operation did not report the injury to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three out of ten staff files lacked the training in the required 6 topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach: In the two year old classroom diaper supplies were on the floor next to the toilet and accessible to the children.    Note: this was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver moved the diaper changing supplies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two out of ten staff training files lacked the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four infant feeding instructions out of ten were not updated within 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the school age room there is a hole in the wall. In the school age room the baseboards are missing. In the school age room there was clorox spray on the back of the toilet accessible to children. Cleaning supplies were under the sink accessible to children in the school age room. In the two year old room an electrical outlet was broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity policy was lacking (A)(C)(D)(F)(G).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Three out of ten staff files lack training in (1)  Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome; (2)  Preventing sudden infant death syndrome; and (3)  Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Three out of ten staff files lacked the required 24 hours of training. One caregiver lacked 24 hours. The second caregiver lacked 11 hours.  The third caregiver lacked 6 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Three out of ten staff files lacked child maltreatment training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two infants were observed in a bucket seat eating their AM snack not buckled in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Share Indoor Activity Space With Written Plan: The operation allowed another business to use licensed childcare space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Share Indoor Activity Space With Written Plan (26 TAC §746.4215(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was over of ratio by one child. The specified age for the group was three years old. A caregiver can have 15 children with the specified age of three years old. The caregiver was supervising 16 children .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation failed to report the change of licensed childcare space in the gym.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: An infant was sleeping with a sleep slack that did not allow a child arms to move freely.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a child was not signed out which resulted in the child being released to the wrong adult.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver released a child to someone who was not designated by the parents/guardians.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement when they released a child to someone they did not know and was not on the approved list to release.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: A classroom was out of ratio when two caregivers  were responsible for a group of 23 children with a specified age group of two years of age.  The child to caregiver ratio for this age group is 22 children to two caregivers, therefore the caregivers were out of ratio by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Three electrical outlets were not covered in the toddler room.  NOTE: this was corrected at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: An infant was sleeping in a pack n play with a pacifier clip attached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of ten children files lacked the address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Four out of ten staff files lacked current CPR and First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Four rooms did not have the children mats labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: All classrooms observed did not have a posted activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed one person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the persons eligibility..
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Seventeen infant feeding schedules were not updated for the month of May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant room had  7 infants to one caregiver which put this room out ratio by 3 children. The 2 year old room had 18 children with the specified age of 2, to one caregiver.    Note: The operation did correct this at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: The electrical outlets were not covered in the Pre-k room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The Pre-k room had 19 children in care with one caregiver. The specified age was 3 years old in the classroom. Due to this reason the classroom was out of ratio.    Note: The operation did correct this at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed two people to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the persons eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: The infant pack n plays had an added soft mattress. The added mattress did not come with the pack n plays.     Note: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Parents were not notified that their children were placed at risk when a firearm was left in a diaper bag of a child by the child's parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not notify licensing when a firearm was found on the premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of six child files did not have an immunization record in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: The director had only 2 of 30 required hours of annual training completed.  2 of 5 caregivers had only 14 of 24 required hours completed.  1 of 5 caregivers had 15 of 24 required hours completed.  1 of 5 caregiver had 3 of 24 required hours completed
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021, revealed that the center had not reported the  number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness: Provider did not report the outbreak of a communicable illness to Child Care Licensing within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §746.305(a)(4))
